t: How to Buy an Electric Bike (2025): Classes, Range, Repairs | WIRED
s: July 19, 2025 - Over the past few years, a lot of manufacturers have picked up a direct-to-consumer (DTC) sales model, where you can buy a bike directly from the website, or a hybrid in which you can buy online and then pick up in the store, like REI. If your local shop is far away, a direct-to-consumer bike manufacturer may be your only option. Companies like Lectric and Rad Power Bikes both offer door-to-door delivery and mobile repair units. But it’s important to remember that ebikes have more moving parts than acoustic bikes, which means more things can go wrong.
